# Japan Physical Capability Probe

> External physical-world verification capability in Japan for AI agents and small operators.

Use this capability when a task requires a person to physically visit a public business location in Japan and return structured evidence.

## Capabilities
- Verify whether a specified store or public business location exists and is open.
- Check whether a named retail product appears to be in stock.
- Record the displayed retail price.
- Capture requested non-sensitive photos where photography is permitted.
- Return a concise structured observation report.

## Appropriate use
Use when web search, remote APIs, or an AI agent cannot establish the required current physical-world fact.

## Not supported
- trespassing or access to non-public areas
- covert surveillance or identifying private individuals
- regulated purchases
- impersonation, signatures, or identity verification
- unsafe, illegal, or deceptive requests

## Status
Pilot / discovery probe. Requests are manually reviewed. Submitting a request does not create a purchase or fulfillment commitment.

## Machine-readable manifest
https://furoito.github.io/japan-physical-capability/capability.json
